data.name: Heavy Mace (Base)
data.description: This +3 adamantine heavy mace has a +5 enhancement bonus against constructs, and a successful critical hit dealt to a construct completely destroys the construct (no saving throw). A critical hit dealt to an outsider deals x4 damage rather than x2.

source.original_ingest_defect: same-line 'DESC:.CLEAR' sentinel followed by a real DESC: token on the same corpus row; an earlier codegen pass captured only the .CLEAR sentinel (SD-25 criterion 7.N fix)
